Thanks for the ping, Aisha. I reviewed the customer's requirements and sketched an approach below. High-level legal stance: we can permit EdgeOps as a named subprocessor for a narrow integration, provided we put specific contractual controls in place.

Key redline proposals (Order Form + DPA annex):
- Annex will list EdgeOps by legal name + address and limit the scope: "EdgeOps will process only forwarding metadata and tokenized logs for the connector and will not persist raw PII beyond X hours."
- Add audit and verification rights: Redwood to require annual SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) and provide attestation within 15 business days of request.
- Encryption: require AES-256 at rest and TLS1.2+ in transit; include high-level topology in the annex as an exhibit (non-sensitive).
- Data residency clause: for EU accounts, processing must remain in EU region; any temporary buffer outside EU requires prior written consent and encryption key custody controls.
- Liability carveout: limit Redwood liability for EdgeOps processing to the amount paid under the Order Form for the connector during the prior 12 months (aim to keep reasonable).
- Termination: allow FinTechCo to require removal of EdgeOps as subprocessor if compliance evidence is not provided within 30 days.

Deliverables I can produce by EOD Tuesday: a one-page DPA annex draft (clean + tracked), and suggested Order Form amendment paragraph. I will flag any clauses that require executive exception (e.g., changes to our standard liability cap).

Action items:
- Karthik: confirm procurement/insurance gating items (PO, certificate of insurance levels).
- Marissa: prepare a short tech Q&A attendance list (who from Infra/SRE should join the 30-min call).
- Aisha: please confirm whether the customer requires DocuSign routing to specific signatories (we can prepare a DocuSign envelope).

I attached a working draft DPA annex (proposed_dpa_annex_v1.docx) with comments; I will remove comments before sending externally once we align.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

- DocuSign: we can prepare an Order Form amendment template; procurement needs the final Order Form language and named signatories to create the envelope.
